name: medpronto
description: Sistema de consultório médico — agenda, prontuário e receituário

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm run start -w backend
